evidence.why: Empty physics callback and separate capture-wait helper.
External capture-damage initializer and animation processing.

facts.rationale: Preserves the directly supported no-op behavior while correcting the claim that all capture-state setup is local to this translation unit.
facts.value: The physics callback has an empty body: it performs no reads, calls, velocity or position updates, timer changes, or state transitions. The separate helper in this unit initializes CaptureWaitMasterHand; CaptureDamageMasterHand initialization and its animation timer processing reside in the neighboring capturemasterhand unit.
